shortfalls.gap: The FP-P1-04 E2E executes read, edit, write and bash/node --check, then the scripted local provider drops with 'LLM request failed: network connection error', so the turn never reaches the final response and the journey-level (L3) claim is unmet on this run.
evidence: ccb4b66d077bbdaf2be8dd9f4efbc3ba1b7da0a5 fix(runtime): stop tool rounds from exhausting the provider retry budget
shortfalls.observed: Root cause identified and fixed on clean candidate ccb4b66d077bbdaf2be8dd9f4efbc3ba1b7da0a5. runAgentPrompt shared one RequestAttemptBudget (maxRetries+1 = 4) across the whole turn and every provider transport call took a slot, including successful tool rounds; the 4-tool loop exhausted it and the final answer was refused with ProviderRequestAttemptBudgetExhaustedError, wrapped by the OpenAI client as APIConnectionError('Connection error.') and surfaced as a retryable transport failure. Successful attempts now release their slot. Three independent full runs of the coding-loop spec passed (2 passed each: the coding journey plus a terminal-disconnect negative), with the repository source unchanged.

shortfalls.proposedAction: Add provider-request diagnostics (connection target, retry, timeout, pid) to the spec, capture the failing HTTP request, fix the 4th-request drop, then rerun three consecutive clean passes plus the negative paths.
shortfalls.blastRadius: current-candidate coding journey and release-critical L3 evidence

shortfalls.gap: Launching the E2E app repeatedly deleted four tracked QQBot skill files under openclaw_runtime/extensions/qqbot/skills/ during Gateway startup, leaving the git worktree dirty until manually restored. Root cause is not yet identified; plugin-skills publish and trim functions are candidates, but a standard junction removal probe did not reproduce target deletion.
evidence: 7999579a6d512fac1794b6ebe53a3dae409b32e4 fix(skills): stop Electron E2E startup from deleting skill sources
shortfalls.observed: Root cause identified and fixed on clean candidate 7999579a6d512fac1794b6ebe53a3dae409b32e4. plugin-skills treated any Windows directory as a runner-owned junction and the synced-skills cleanup recursively removed entries through a junction into the tracked source. Removal is now restricted to real links and the cleanup refuses paths that overlap a protected source root. Focused unit 42/42 passed; three Electron launches and an app-smoke run left every tracked file byte-identical with the worktree guard reporting ok and zero surviving Electron processes.
shortfalls.impact: Any E2E or normal startup path that deletes tracked source files corrupts the working tree and can silently alter packaged inputs. It also makes clean-candidate evidence unreliable.
shortfalls.proposedAction: Instrument skill-root cleanup paths to log path, realpath, link type and decision before deletion; add an E2E guard that fails when tracked files change; then fix and rerun the full E2E suite.
shortfalls.blastRadius: tracked source inputs during E2E; may invalidate clean-candidate and package evidence
shortfalls.pathToGa: instrument deletion paths, add a tracked-file mutation guard and rerun launch/full E2E
